name: Halima Herrera-Kyei
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Halima Herrera-Kyei are athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 27, their expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces — and they make no effort to hide it.

They inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. They work as a netrunner out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Halima Herrera-Kyei agrees on two things: they are worth the fee, and they are terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Halima Herrera-Kyei can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: Halima Herrera-Kyei's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Halima Herrera-Kyei's reputation — and a price for silence
Halima Herrera-Kyei discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: Halima Herrera-Kyei is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.
augmentations: Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces. Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with corded muscle — the physique of someone who moves for a living, whether climbing or fighting. Low body fat, defined shoulders and forearms.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally, with selective bleached streaks along the left side
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut with longer crown, pulled back in a tight braid or left loose depending on operational needs
physical_description.eye_color: Brown with subtle amber undertone — appears to catch light distinctly, possibly enhanced low-light sensitivity
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden undertones — reflects mixed West African and Iberian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, angular jaw, minimal body hair. Skin condition is pristine — the nanite-laced synthetic blood keeps it smooth and unblemished, almost unnaturally so. Expression typically neutral, eyes monitoring.
distinguishing_marks: Chrome gecko-grip implants visible on fingertips and toe pads — metallic silver with subtle iridescent sheen, most obvious when hands are in use or ungloved
A thin scar along the right temple, barely visible, likely from early augmentation work or a close call
No tattoos — deliberate choice to avoid identification markers in their line of work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Gecko-grip fingertip and toe pad implants are immediately apparent — chrome edges catch light, creating a distinctive metallic gleam on digits. The synthetic blood circulating beneath the skin gives a faint luminescence under certain lighting that's subtly wrong. Otherwise augmentations are invisible — the nanites do their work silently.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise. They move like someone calculating angles and weight distribution — a climber's awareness of surfaces and leverage. When still, there's coiled readiness rather than relaxation. Rarely fidgets. Eye contact is deliberate, testing rather than social.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical — functional over fashionable. Black or dark grey synthetic performance fabrics, cargo pants or fitted thermals with multiple pockets and quick-release seals. Reinforced climbing gloves (often removed to display chrome). Unmarked tactical jacket. Minimal branding. Footwear is grippy-soled — climbing shoes modified for urban use. When in cover, shifts to aggressively mundane workwear, the kind that makes them invisible. Jewelry limited to a single encrypted data-ring on left hand.
